justification: Both are tall weathered stone monoliths bearing shallow relief organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a distinct banded row of repeated small motifs crossing the face in each. Beyond that the content and manner diverge completely: A consists of dense, uniform rectangular cartouches of tightly packed abstract/script-like units in flat, rectilinear relief, whereas B shows large, rounded, curvilinear animal figures (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, arch-like shapes) rendered in bolder, more modelled relief at a much larger scale.
